scoring_justification: The checker cannot re-run the numerical mean-field solution; instead it compares the agent's output to the paper's analytic phase boundary expression (Eq.10) and the reported critical point coordinates with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Analytic phase boundary function and critical point reference values
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly from the paper's analytic expression and reported approximate coordinates
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published result, authoritative for the reproduction task.

outputs.description: Points on the first-order liquid-liquid phase transition line. The checker compares the reported βnmu values against a theoretical reference curve.
The coordinates of the critical point terminating the first-order line. The checker compares these values to the expected critical point coordinates.

output_contract.notes: Both outputs are evaluated by comparison to the correct theoretical values, allowing small deviations due to implementation differences.
